newsitem.title: UK: Mark firm, keeps grip on Nordics, Fr franc softens.
newsitem.headline: Mark firm, keeps grip on Nordics, Fr franc softens.

text.p: The mark firmed on its European crosses, riding higher on the back of Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer's comment late on Thursday that the central bank was not seeking a further weakening of the mark, traders said.

The Norwegian crown struggled to regain some ground after hitting a low around 4.1420 per mark overnight, its worst level since early January, amid continued long liquidation, mainly by U.S. funds. The crown dragged down other Nordic units with it.
Rumours about a French cabinet reshuffle, a dissolution of parliament and budget deficit concerns provided a negative backdrop for French bonds and weighed on the franc.
